purpose: Configurable demonstration rules for CARE. These are educational prototype heuristics, not clinically validated decision rules.

rules.name: Platelet decline plus bleeding while anticoagulant order is active
rules.title: Clinical context changed — clinician review required
rules.message: An active anticoagulant order coexists with a substantial platelet decline and a bleeding note. Review the evidence and current patient context.

rules.name: Stale coagulation data
rules.title: Latest coagulation result may be stale
rules.message: The latest coagulation result is older than the configured demo freshness window. The current context may be incomplete; obtain or confirm current information according to local workflow.

rules.name: Missing infusion-pump telemetry
rules.title: Infusion-pump telemetry unavailable
rules.message: No current telemetry event was received from the configured demo pump source. Do not infer that the infusion is running or stopped.

rules.name: Vital-sign review threshold
rules.title: Vital signs require clinical review
rules.message: One or more configured vital-sign thresholds are crossed in this synthetic scenario. Verify the measurement and review in clinical context.

rules.name: Conflicting source values
rules.title: Conflicting medication status across sources
rules.message: Mock sources report different medication-order statuses. Preserve both source values and request reconciliation; do not silently choose one.
